test_plan.volume_note: The form logged 173 submissions in 30 days, above about 100 a month, so an A/B test can reach a clear answer. Test one change at a time, starting with the field cuts.
hypotheses: If we make Phone, Business name and the message optional and merge the name fields, then completion rate will rise from 36.6%, because 8 required fields fail the demo-form range and 3 of them can be optional without losing what sales routes on.
If we put every field full width on mobile and make Phone type=tel, then mobile completion will move closer to desktop, because mobile completes at 49% of the desktop rate on the same form.
If we change 'Submit' to 'Book my demo' and add a 'what happens next' line, then completion will rise, because the button and the text around it don't say what a submit gets.
test_plan.watch_quality: About 1 in 4 demos becomes a paying customer today. Track that rate next to completions: optional fields can bring in weaker leads, and the business type and team size questions stay required for that reason.

check_by_hand: Submit the empty form on a phone: does it jump to the first error, and does each message say how to fix it, next to the field?
Type a wrong email: is it flagged when leaving the field, not on every keystroke? Does a valid answer show it was accepted?
Type name+test@gmail.com and name@gmial.com: is the alias accepted, and is the typo caught with a suggestion?
Type an international number (+44 20 7946 0000) in Phone: is it accepted, and formatted as you type?
After an error, is everything typed still there?
After a submit: is there a clear success state, and does the button show it is working while it waits?

Lead quality by field: the lead-to-customer rate was given as an overall figure, not per form version.
